title: RFC 3977 conformance: POST, NEWNEWS, NEWGROUPS
description:
Test POST: send a valid article, verify 240 response, retrieve via ARTICLE. Test POST with missing mandatory header, verify 441. Test NEWNEWS: post 3 articles, issue NEWNEWS with timestamp before posting, verify all 3 Message-IDs returned. Test NEWGROUPS with timestamp. Artifact: tests/conformance/post_and_news.py.

Acceptance criteria:
- POST roundtrip: posted article retrievable by message-ID and article number
- POST with missing From: header returns 441
- NEWNEWS returns correct Message-IDs for the time window
- NEWGROUPS returns only groups created after the specified timestamp
- All response codes match RFC 3977 tables
